galleries.name: Sackler Wing - Temple of Dendur
galleries.description: Massive glass-walled wing housing the complete Temple of Dendur, with reflecting pool and Central Park view
galleries.descriptionCN: 玻璃幕墙展厅完整保存古埃及丹铎神庙，水池倒映，可眺望中央公园

galleries.name: Egyptian Art Galleries
galleries.description: 39 rooms of ancient Egyptian art, 26,000+ objects displayed chronologically
galleries.descriptionCN: 39 个展厅按年代陈列 26,000+ 件古埃及文物，木乃伊、石棺与哈特谢普苏特坐像

galleries.name: Assyrian Sculpture Court
galleries.description: Monumental lamassu (human-headed winged lions) and relief panels from ancient Assyrian palaces
galleries.descriptionCN: 来自亚述宫殿的巨型人首翼狮（拉玛苏）与浮雕石板，镇守门厅

galleries.name: Islamic Art Galleries
galleries.description: 1,300 years of Islamic civilization art, geometric patterns, calligraphy, ceramics
galleries.descriptionCN: 1300 年伊斯兰文明艺术：几何纹样、书法、陶瓷与大马士革厅

galleries.name: Lauder Galleries of Arms and Armor
galleries.nameCN: 武器与盔甲馆（劳德展厅）
galleries.description: World-class arms and armor collection including Henry VIII's armor, Japanese samurai gear
galleries.descriptionCN: 世界级武器盔甲收藏：亨利八世铠甲、日本武士装备，骑马盔甲阵列极具震撼

galleries.name: Greek and Roman Sculpture Court
galleries.description: Two-story Ionic-columned hall with skylights, marble statues including Three Graces
galleries.descriptionCN: 双层爱奥尼柱廊大厅，天窗下的大理石雕像群，含《美惠三女神》

galleries.name: Astor Court (Chinese Garden)
galleries.description: Ming-style courtyard modeled after the Master of Nets Garden in Suzhou
galleries.descriptionCN: 以苏州网师园为蓝本的明代风格庭院，曼哈顿中心的一片江南

galleries.name: Chinese Art Galleries
galleries.description: Chinese art spanning 4,000 years, including calligraphy, porcelain, paintings
galleries.descriptionCN: 横跨四千年的中国艺术：书法、瓷器、绘画与佛教造像

galleries.name: European Paintings
galleries.description: 2,500+ European paintings from 13th-19th centuries, including works by Rembrandt, Vermeer, Van Gogh, Monet, Degas
galleries.descriptionCN: 2500+ 件 13-19 世纪欧洲绘画，伦勃朗、维米尔、梵高、莫奈、德加云集

galleries.name: Impressionist and Post-Impressionist Galleries
galleries.nameCN: 印象派与后印象派展厅
galleries.description: Monet, Van Gogh, Degas, Cezanne - the most popular section of European Paintings
galleries.descriptionCN: 莫奈、梵高、德加、塞尚——全馆人气最高的展厅区域

galleries.name: Dutch Golden Age Galleries
galleries.description: Vermeer, Rembrandt, Hals - Dutch 17th century masters
galleries.descriptionCN: 维米尔、伦勃朗、哈尔斯——荷兰 17 世纪黄金时代大师之作

galleries.name: American Wing
galleries.description: 75+ galleries of American art and design, 17th-20th century, including period rooms
galleries.descriptionCN: 75+ 展厅呈现 17-20 世纪美国艺术与设计，含《华盛顿横渡特拉华河》与《X夫人》

galleries.name: Robert Lehman Wing
galleries.description: Old Master paintings in an intimate setting, quieter galleries
galleries.descriptionCN: 雷曼家族珍藏的欧洲古典大师绘画，环境私密安静

galleries.name: Modern and Contemporary Art
galleries.description: 20th century art including Pollock, Warhol, and contemporary works
galleries.descriptionCN: 20 世纪至今：波洛克《秋之韵》、沃霍尔与当代新作

galleries.name: Roof Garden
galleries.description: Seasonal rooftop garden with commissioned art installation, Central Park and skyline views
galleries.descriptionCN: 季节性开放的屋顶花园，年度委任艺术装置，俯瞰中央公园与曼哈顿天际线
galleries.noteCN: 约 4-10 月开放，视天气而定；2025 季后闭园大修
